title: Papercut
lyrics:
[00:22.34]Why does it feel like night today?
[00:23.91]Something in here's not right today
[00:25.55]Why am I so uptight today?
[00:27.14]Paranoia's all I got left
[00:28.78]I don't know what stressed me first
[00:30.22]Or how the pressure was fed
[00:31.74]But I know just what it feels like
[00:33.22]To have a voice in the back of my head
[00:34.97]It's like a face that I hold inside
[00:36.35]A face that awakes when I close my eyes
[00:37.95]A face that watches every time I lie
[00:39.49]A face that laughs every time I fall (And watches everything)
[00:42.35]So I know that when it's time to sink or swim
[00:44.51]That the face inside is hearing me
[00:46.30]Right underneath my skin
[00:47.34]It's like I'm paranoid, lookin' over my back
[00:50.54]It's like a whirlwind inside of my head
[00:53.72]It's like I can't stop what I'm hearing within
[00:56.89]It's like the face inside is right beneath my skin
[01:00.71]I know I've got a face in me
[01:02.34]Points out all my mistakes to me
[01:03.93]You've got a face on the inside too
[01:05.46]And your paranoia's probably worse
[01:07.07]I don't know what set me off first
[01:08.55]But I know what I can't stand
[01:09.96]Everybody acts like the fact of the matter is
[01:11.54]I can't add up to what you can
[01:12.88]But everybody has a face that they hold inside
[01:14.72]A face that awakes when I close my eyes
[01:16.22]A face that watches every time they lie
[01:17.83]A face that laughs every time they fall (And watches everything)
[01:20.69]So you know that when it's time to sink or swim
[01:22.97]That the face inside is watching you too
[01:24.68]Right inside your skin
[01:25.71]It's like I'm paranoid, lookin' over my back
[01:28.91]It's like a whirlwind inside of my head
[01:32.12]It's like I can't stop what I'm hearing within
[01:35.27]It's like the face inside is right beneath the skin
[01:38.57]It's like I'm paranoid, lookin' over my back
[01:41.71]It's like a whirlwind inside of my head
[01:44.89]It's like I can't stop what I'm hearing within
[01:48.10]It's like the face inside is right beneath my skin
[01:52.49]The face inside is right beneath your skin
[01:55.71]The face inside is right beneath your skin
[01:58.87]The face inside is right beneath your skin
[02:04.24]The sun goes down
[02:14.07]I feel the light betray me
[02:16.82]The sun goes down
[02:26.83]I feel the light betray me (The sun)
[02:29.63]It's like I'm paranoid, lookin' over my back
[02:32.85]It's like a whirlwind inside of my head
[02:36.04]It's like I can't stop what I'm hearing within
[02:39.25]It's like the face inside is right beneath the skin (I feel the light betray me)

[02:48.82]It's like I can't stop what I'm hearing within
